limitations: One fixed seed and one start/goal per stage; smoke integration, not a timing benchmark.
Geometric plans check discretized snapshots, not continuous collision or kinodynamic feasibility proof. Shared execution monitors physical collisions each 0.25ms step.
Collision checking honors the existing MuJoCo collision masks/exclusions and collision meshes; visual-only geometry is not collision geometry.
Only seven right-arm joints planned; left arm, grippers, torso remain in full MuJoCo validity and execution checks.
Contact stage uses the shared Cartesian IK controller, not OMPL contact planning.
Peak4.9675N is close to the5N shared abort limit; no claim of broadly safe contact-force regulation.
Actual force-bearing contact occurs at positive9um separation inside configured contact margin; no geometric penetration was observed.
No full folding, grasping or locking tested.
All robot-run planner validity samples were valid and final two-waypoint paths were direct joint interpolations; this does not test obstacle-detour superiority.
